safety_rules: Never delete an active PR head.
On every PR close event, delete the exact closed head ref only when the remote SHA still equals the PR head SHA; if the ref moved, preserve it as new work.
After exact merged-head closeout, enumerate live refs once and delete non-protected, non-active-PR branches only when GitHub reports zero commits ahead of develop.
delete_after_merge is an explicit deletion supplement for reviewed superseded/divergent refs, not the sole discovery source.
Never bulk-merge or auto-delete a divergent branch with unique commits; selectively salvage or explicitly supersede it first.
Branches with unresolved unique commits remain protected until reviewed.
Cleanup runs only from an exact-head develop merge checkout on GitHub-hosted Windows.
A PR must not be closed while it is the only named salvage source; salvage or record the exact commit SHA first. Closing a PR declares that branch lifecycle finished.
